choose.otherwise: WITH events AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT populate_time AS event_time, peer_id FROM ban_history WHERE populate_time >= #{startAt} AND populate_time < #{endAt} UNION ALL SELECT last_time_seen AS event_time, peer_id FROM swarm_tracker WHERE last_time_seen >= #{startAt} AND last_time_seen < #{endAt} ), grouped AS ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(peer_id, ''), 'Unknown') AS name, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM events GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(peer_id, ''), 'Unknown') ) SELECT name, value, SUM(value) OVER () AS total FROM grouped ORDER BY value DESC, name LIMIT #{limit}

choose.when: WITH grouped AS ( SELECT bucket, peer_client_name AS name, SUM(ban_count)::bigint AS value FROM dashboard_ban_daily_client WHERE bucket >= #{startAt} AND bucket < #{endAt} GROUP BY bucket, peer_client_name ), totals AS ( SELECT name, SUM(value)::bigint AS total FROM grouped GROUP BY name ), top_names AS ( SELECT name FROM totals ORDER BY total DESC, name LIMIT #{limit} ), selected AS ( SELECT grouped.bucket, CASE WHEN top_names.name IS NULL THEN 'Other' ELSE grouped.name END AS name, SUM(grouped.value)::bigint AS value FROM grouped LEFT JOIN top_names ON top_names.name = grouped.name GROUP BY grouped.bucket, CASE WHEN top_names.name IS NULL THEN 'Other' ELSE grouped.name END ) SELECT bucket, name, value FROM selected ORDER BY bucket, name

mapper.select: SELECT last_user_agent AS user_agent, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM userapp WHERE banned_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND last_user_agent IS NOT NULL AND last_user_agent <> '' GROUP BY last_user_agent ORDER BY value DESC

WITH grouped AS ( SELECT CASE family(uh.ip) WHEN 4 THEN 'IPv4' WHEN 6 THEN 'IPv6' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS name, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM userapps_heartbeat uh JOIN userapp ua ON ua.id = uh.userapp_id WHERE uh.last_seen_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND ua.banned_at IS NULL GROUP BY family(uh.ip) ) SELECT name, value, SUM(value) OVER () AS total FROM grouped ORDER BY name

WITH grouped AS ( SELECT COALESCE( NULLIF(uh.geoip #>> '{city,cnCity}', ''), NULLIF(uh.geoip #>> '{city,name}', ''), NULLIF(uh.geoip #>> '{country,name}', ''), 'Unknown' ) AS name, COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM userapps_heartbeat uh JOIN userapp ua ON ua.id = uh.userapp_id WHERE uh.last_seen_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND uh.geoip IS NOT NULL AND ua.banned_at IS NULL GROUP BY name ) SELECT name, value, SUM(value) OVER () AS total FROM grouped ORDER BY value DESC, name LIMIT #{limit}
